adopted_recommendations: Patient/cycle grouping and training-only fixed or grouped-selected probe parameters.
Compare visual heads with pixel, intensity, metadata and prior controls; blank is OOD, not the real-image prior.
Pair opposite truths at the same patient and level; substitutions use displayed-image truth.
Report raw accuracy, per-class recall, paired margins and training-only prior recentering separately.
Correspondence is identity matching, not disease progression; update counts are not accuracy.
limitations: This is a tool-free methodological consultation, not independent inspection of patient data, source code or actual experimental outcomes.
Full original critique and exact execution receipt remain private and immutable.
Clinical/generalization claims and any novel efficacy remain unverified.

preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.Claude_position: The critique example compares an AUC difference lower bound with0.5+delta.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.root_position: Differences must be compared with delta;0.5 is a reference for an AUC itself. No adoption of the example KILL rule.

preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.Claude_position: The critique proposes bitwise equality and treats non-epsilon-regime differences as defects.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.root_position: Finite additive epsilon perturbs every nonzero variance group under rescaling; roundoff also prevents a bitwise-equality requirement. Use algebraic limits and explicit tolerances.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.topic: Exact binary invariance with epsilon/bitwise test

preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.Claude_position: A probe matching a strong pixel baseline or failing a positive-CI margin is suggested as a KILL of representation adequacy.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.root_position: Equal perfect classifiers provide a counterexample to inadequate representation; a wide interval can be inconclusive rather than falsifying. Label NOT_VERIFIED when underpowered.

preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.Claude_position: Shuffled-label or text-only training is presented as a no-new-supervision baseline.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.root_position: Retain the unchanged B28 no-update baseline. Shuffled-label training is an additional intervention/control, not the no-new-supervision baseline.

preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.Claude_position: The critique suggests gating any RL interpretation on supervised success.
preserved_disagreements_and_reproducible.root_position: Complete the explicitly frozen original RL study as controls; interpretation remains qualified. Do not cancel or silently alter approved arms.
